tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Company facts for Jenesis Travel: licence, contact, WhatsApp, enquiry-led model. Call this first. If the user wants a real person, share the WhatsApp URL.

tools.name: list_journeys
tools.description: List published Jenesis journeys, residences, group programmes, and packages (including Phuket Fit). Live CMS data. Enquiry-led — not a booking inventory.

tools.name: get_journey
tools.description: Get one published journey, residence, group programme, or package by slug. Use list_journeys if the slug is unknown.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.description: Published FAQs from the Jenesis CMS, optionally filtered by pillar or search text.

tools.name: estimate_budget
tools.description: Indicative independent USD range from the Jenesis budget calculator. Not a quote. Mid-range to ultra-luxury is what Jenesis plans.

tools.name: start_enquiry
tools.description: File a planning enquiry with Jenesis Travel. Call only after the user has stated their own name and email in the conversation and confirmed they want Jenesis to reply. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company · Private data: get_company, start_enquiry · Public sink: get_company, start_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company · Private data: get_company, start_enquiry · Public sink: get_company, start_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
